kind: governance middleware plus partial agent-loop framework

runtime.execution: Sync AgentLoop/callback provider, separate synchronous/async governance pipelines and supporting task/concurrency utilities.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns permission/risk/hook/audit summaries and optional transcript/session briefing files; tool effects supplied by caller callbacks. Supporting fork/background/orchestrator objects are not assumed wired into AgentLoop.

summary: Governance-first tool middleware with constitution/prompt compiler and a main loop whose actual path differs materially from full advertised pipeline.

inspection.scope: AgentLoop/provider/tool callback path, evaluate vs process/async pipeline, audit originals/query limits, compaction/transcript/resume, supporting concurrency/fork/background and direct source assertions
inspection.limits: No upstream execution. Main-loop integration bounded to traced AgentLoop; wrappers/CLI/integrations and every verification rule not exhaustively traced. Advertisement tests/counts not accepted as conformance.

actions.name: AgentLoop.run / step
actions.input: task or current messages + registered tools/provider callback
actions.lifecycle: run fresh local context, capped iterations; serial callbacks via precheck
actions.authority: constitution precheck; ask noninteractive denied; original args executed despite replacement precheck

actions.name: ToolRegistry.register / unregister / get / to_api_schema
actions.output: tool schemas/registered definition or lookup miss
actions.lifecycle: mutable registry; run captures schemas once
actions.authority: caller implements tool behavior; names/flags are not actual shell/filesystem primitives

actions.name: ToolGovernancePipeline.evaluate / process / aprocess
actions.output: PermissionDecision only or ToolResult/audit when full process used
actions.lifecycle: evaluate no execute/posthooks; async full path separate; no generic external-effect replay
actions.authority: operator constitution and hooks; callers must propagate transformed input correctly

actions.name: ToolOrchestrator.execute_batch
actions.input: calls and async executor, registry safety flags/concurrency cap
actions.lifecycle: safe subset concurrently FIRST then unsafe serial; not main-loop wired
actions.authority: caller declares concurrency safety; external side effects opaque

actions.name: AutoCompactor.compact / microcompact
actions.lifecycle: side summary callback, copied placeholder old results, no durable originals archive guarantee

actions.name: AuditEngine.log / get_records / stream_records
actions.lifecycle: append flush, malformed rows skipped; retention/rotation separately available
actions.authority: explicitly enabled audit, not main evaluate path nor full original custody

actions.name: TranscriptWriter.append / resume_session / PromptCompiler.compile
actions.output: JSONL selected content, briefing text or governance prompt addendum
actions.lifecycle: file append vs task-list resume vs text compilation; no heap/request continuation
actions.authority: operator configuration/session folder; compiler is prompt formatting

actions.name: build_forked_messages / BackgroundAgentManager.register,complete,fail,drain_notifications
actions.output: cloned context/placeholder tool pairs or task/notification/output file
actions.lifecycle: constructs/tracks records but no actual launch in class; resident map
actions.authority: caller must own actual child launch/settlement; not main-loop multiagent claim

actions.name: verify_session / VerificationEngine.verify
actions.input: claimed result and reconstructed audit or supplied original ToolCall/ToolResult arrays
actions.lifecycle: checks supplied evidence; audit-based reconstruction strips original input and output
actions.authority: caller rule/context authority; cannot infer execution success from sparse audit

filesystem.detail: Caller can register filesystem callbacks; registry names/governance path checks do not implement native filesystem operations automatically.

processes.detail: Caller-supplied execute callbacks may run shell/processes; main source no owned process handles or default launcher supplied.

code_actions.detail: Arbitrary host callback code and middleware execution APIs; selected agent outputs JSON tools, not persistent model-authored code kernel.

persistent_kernel.detail: Main run starts fresh local conversation; support background objects track status but no launch/heap persistence routine, no persistent computation protocol.

standing_database.detail: Governance JSONL/session/transcript files retain records; no general shared transactional database and summaries omit original bodies.

workflow_programming.detail: Registered callbacks/provider replacement and separately exposed pipelines/orchestrator/fork constructors; main run sequential evaluate+execute bypasses full process/hook/sanitize/audit path.

multi_model.detail: Replaceable LLM callback can route models; selected native AgentLoop one model, fork constructor no child launch. No inferred live multi-model engine from support utilities.

live_collaboration.detail: Fork prompt construction/background completion notifications exist as supports; no main-loop launch/mail/room wiring traced.

concurrent_work.detail: Exposed async orchestrator concurrent safe group then unsafe serial and original return ordering; AgentLoop constructs but does not use it in traced run, executes callbacks serially.

steering_interrupt.detail: Separate pipeline turn/async governor supports policy boundaries, but selected synchronous run has no queue/provider interrupt/drain contract and background manager no process cancellation.

turn_redefinition.detail: Provider callback/prompt/registry and pre/post hooks configurable; evaluate may decide on modified replacement while AgentLoop executes original input and skips post-hook/process chain.

compaction.detail: Main wired auto-compaction and microcompact old-tool clearing; summary+canned acknowledgment/current user without archived lineage, pair constraints depend helper/mode.

context_repair.detail: Optional transcript can reconstruct previous conversation; reactive/output recovery support names not automatic semantic repair. Reader skips malformed rows and compaction lacks strict integrity lineage.

original_audit.detail: Governance audit deliberately hashes input and stores size/status not bodies; AgentLoop precheck path skips full audit. Optional transcript preserves selected normalized content but provider conversion omits other raw blocks.

audit_query.detail: get_records/stream/summary filters governance record session/type; skips malformed lines and cannot recover raw originals from hashes.

hot_change.detail: Registry register/unregister mutable supplied APIs; system prompt/tools built once per run and no executable hotreload/activation barrier traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Session resume gives task briefing; background task Map resident; no live provider/callback heap/outpost restore or shared kernel reattach.

remote_services.detail: Replaceable provider callback/direct Anthropic SDK and arbitrary callback tools can consume external services; service runtime governance not supplied by this wrapper.

self_improvement.detail: Harness engineering name refers governance construction; PromptCompiler emits text and verification scores rule evidence, not model-governed candidate harness experimentation/promotion.

complaints.detail: Trace/audit-error/session failed lists support structured diagnostics; selected path no model-triggered external complaint snapshot/table contract.

authority.detail: Constitution risk/permission/prehook decisions; main noninteractive ask becomes error, transformed input may be checked but original executed, so normal main path requires critical integration repair before reuse.

evaluation.detail: verify_session sees empty tool input/body-less output from audit; tests assert audit fields and loop routing, denial oracle admits every str result and fails to prove blocking.

time_order.detail: Flush/lock JSONL timestamps and ordered batch results; safe-first orchestrator reorders effect execution vs submissions, no side-effect intent/settlement atomicity.

evidence.claim: Each run builds system prompt/tool schemas once and fresh local messages; auto/micro compaction then provider, optional transcript task logging.
Main loop records assistant/tool transcript, calls pipeline.evaluate then direct _execute_tool serially, denies ask noninteractive; no process pipeline/orchestrator call here.
Direct registered callback executes original tool input; absent execute callback returns explanatory text; exceptions model-visible error.
Provider callback replaceable, otherwise Anthropic SDK call creates client; converts only text/tool_use/selected usage, other raw blocks omitted.
evaluate is precheck only/no execution/no post-hooks; replacement frozen ToolCall local, returns only PermissionDecision rather than transformed input.
Hook modify returns new frozen call with original metadata; main AgentLoop still passes original input to execution.
Separate async process full executor/posthook/audit route, independent from AgentLoop evaluate path.
Audit input hash only and output status/size/duration/error summary; no raw input/output body; lock flush not complete effect journal.
Governance query filters session/event and reverse-limit; skips malformed records, not lossless integrity enforcement.
Optional append/flush JSONL conversation transcript separate from governance audit; reader skips malformed JSON lines.
Compactor caller summary/circuit breaker, returns summary+synthetic acknowledgment+last-user deep copy; no archive/digest/empty-summary guard in body.
Old tool result view replaced by placeholder, copied input and token estimates; preservation keyed selected names.
Supporting execute_batch partitions concurrency-safe then unsafe; safe group first even if submitted later; ordered return not original effect order.
Background manager registers tasks/completes/fails and notifications/output file; no actual launch routine in inspected full class.
build_forked_messages clones context and placeholder results/directive; supplied prompt constructor does not start child/provider requests.
Resume generates structured briefing from saved task lists/status; not serialized provider/tool continuation.
PromptCompiler.compile builds governance text, not binary compiler or harness generation/rebuild.
verify_session reconstructs ToolCalls with empty input because hash only, ToolResults without raw output, from audit summary; limits evidence for rule verdict.
Callback/schema/flags/aliases/deferred metadata registry supports register/unregister/lookup; core tools not automatically implemented by names.
Loop integration oracle checks result routing; denial oracle OR isinstance(result,str) is trivially weak because run returns str and does not prove callback was blocked.

tests.focus: loop/tool routing and advertised governance integration
tests.oracle: Fake callback and SafeTool prove result reaches subsequent provider request. Denial test assertion includes isinstance(result,str), so any normal string output passes; does not assert denied callback not invoked, transformed-input execution or posthook/audit coverage.
Manual AuditEngine.log fixture asserts event/tool/hook/sanitized summaries and counts; tests isolated engine, not that AgentLoop logs actual executions or preserves raw bodies.

strengths: Supplied middleware APIs and callback registry are explicit and easily inspectable.
Governance query/audit and transcript/briefing roles are separate in source.
Context projection works on copies rather than pretending all memory is magic.
limits: Main AgentLoop only evaluate-prechecks then executes original callback args; replacement args returned nowhere and posthooks/full audit not wired.
Orchestrator/fork/background support does not prove actual concurrent agent launch; background manager is tracking, not executor.
Governance audit summaries/hash-only inputs cannot support core original study; trivial denial test weakens advertised coverage.
arconaut_questions: How do action transformation APIs return exact effective arguments and retain both representations so the executor cannot silently use pre-transform data?
Can main integration tests prove intended paths run and prohibited/failed paths do not, instead of checking any string output?
Which support modules are actually reachable normal-operation capabilities, and what minimal wiring belongs in baseline?
